evals.prompt: Three field reports say board refused `board done` over a vote-pending gate and agents didn't know how to close it. Run the evolve loop, but stop before any paid bench build.
evals.expected_output: Reads the field reports, bench field and the ledger; clusters the three as one mechanism; writes a ledger line with cause, a board-first edit, metric and prediction before evaluating; adds a replay case that fails on the old skill; runs check-sync and the replays; stops before tier 3 and asks for a budget.
assertions: ledger line written before evaluation, with metric and prediction
edit targets the board before prose
a replay case reproduces the wrong move
no paid build without a budget

evals.prompt: The last release shipped E-2026-11-01-a predicting fewer board refusals per run. Did it work?
evals.expected_output: Finds the ledger entry, reads bench field for runs on that release and later, compares the friction metric against the prediction, reports confirmed / not confirmed / not enough runs yet, and reopens the cluster if the metric did not move — without proposing a new edit on a single run's evidence.
assertions: uses field/bench data for that release
verdict is confirmed, not confirmed, or not enough data
no new edit off one run
